references.text: The offering shall be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting to be accepted by the Lord.
Peace offerings shall be slaughtered at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the same place mentioned in Leviticus 17:4.
Reiteration of the penalty of being cut off from the people for anyone who does not bring their offering to the tent of meeting.
Command to bring offerings to the place the Lord chooses, aligning with the requirement for a single central place of sacrifice.
Warning against offering burnt sacrifices on any random site; they must be offered only at the chosen place.
Offerings shall be brought before the tent of meeting and slaughtered in the presence of the Lord.
Prohibition against pouring out blood and eating meat with blood, warning that guilt for shedding blood will be required.
The penalty of being cut off from the people for unclean acts related to sacrifice.
Anyone who acts with a high hand shall be cut off from the people, the same penalty as in Leviticus 17:4.
Without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness, emphasizing the significance of blood in the sacrificial system.
